en.sayed-ali-raza: O creatures of Allāh! Fear Allāh
and anticipate your death by good actions. Purchase everlasting joy by paying transitory things — pleasures of this world.
Get ready for the journey, for you are being driven, and prepare yourself for death, since it is hovering over you.
Be a people who wake up when called,
and who know that this world is not their abode, and so have it changed (with the next).
